papers.title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
papers.translated_title: CoSel：以合作为选择的端到端驾驶方法
papers.author: Yiping Li
papers.summary: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.
papers.translated_summary: 协同驾驶可以将车辆的感知范围扩展到自身传感器之外，但现有的协同端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖协同驾驶示范来学习如何使用这些信息。在此类数据中，共享信息应当改变驾驶决策的时刻十分稀少，因而对这种行为的学习提供的监督有限。我们认为，协同不必由规划器来学习。相反，对共享信息作出反应需要预测周围智能体的运动，并从自车规划器的候选轨迹中选择一种响应。我们提出 CoSel，一种“协同即选择”框架，它保持规划器及其仅依赖自车的输入不变。一个单独训练的协同预测器利用来自自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测，预测周围智能体及其未来运动。CoSel 依据这些预测评估规划器的候选轨迹，在规划器的选择仍然安全时保留该选择，并在共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全替代方案。每一次安全干预都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。在闭环评估中，CoSel 在 V2Xverse 上取得 70.7 的驾驶得分，比表现最好的对比协同方法高出 7.5 分，并在 MDrive 上取得 85.8 的最高平均驾驶得分。在自车检测缺失的情况下，CoSel 在 72 个场景中的碰撞次数仅从 17 增加到 19，而现有协同端到端模型则从 19 增加到 32。

papers.title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
papers.translated_title: TrialAgentBench：评估用于临床试验分析和长周期药物开发决策的AI智能体
papers.author: Bradley Segal
papers.summary: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.
papers.translated_summary: 临床药物开发是一个长周期、高风险的过程，需要基于获取成本高昂（耗费金钱和时间）的信息做出序贯决策。AI智能体已展现出科学分析的能力，但目前尚无既定方法来评估它们在这些决策上的表现，因为真实试验成本高昂、涉及人员，且永远不会揭示反事实结果。我们推出TrialAgentBench，这是一个用于评估AI智能体在临床试验分析和药物开发决策方面表现的基准，它使用真相已知的模拟试验，并嵌入一家虚构药物申办方的数据记录中。我们公开发布近3,500项任务，范围从分析单一试验到管理受预算和时间约束的多阶段项目。我们通过在新试验上重新运行其代码来对每项分析评分，并通过其决策所实现的价值来对每个项目评分。在24个闭源和开源权重模型中，最强的智能体能够分析原始、杂乱的试验记录，与流程感知分析的差距在6%以内，即使在某一假设被违反时也是如此，其95%置信区间在94%至95%的情况下包含真实效应。在过去一年中，最佳模型从比该分析高出19%、并在15%的任务上出现严重遗漏，改善到3.5%和1%。限制它们的是在不确定性下基于证据进行决策：何时纠正、购买何种证据、何时停止。最强的智能体过于谨慎，在记录错误相同的情况下，在83%的任务上进行了不必要的纠正。在药物项目上，最佳智能体仍有相当大的提升空间，达到预言机所实现价值的48%，而基于规则的开发者达到58%，其他模型则落后24%至66%。各代模型在處理数据和证据方面表现出持续改进，但差异很大。最强的模型可以充当胜任的分析师，但尚不能做出可靠的长周期决策。

papers.title: Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
papers.translated_title: 废物分类器能识别从未见过的物品吗？家庭和医疗废物上的对象不相交评估
papers.author: Nusrat Jahan
papers.summary: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.
papers.translated_summary: 自动垃圾分类支持源头分类，从而实现回收利用，并将有害医疗物品排除在生活垃圾之外。垃圾分类研究通常报告在随机图像划分上接近完美的准确率，而这种划分会将同一物品的照片同时放入训练集和测试集。为衡量分类器对从未见过物品的识别能力，我们构建了BanglaWaste-23，包含来自孟加拉国的23个生活和医疗废物类别的172个物品的4,160张图像。每张图像还记录了其所示的具体物理物品。我们采用对象不相交的五折交叉验证和随机划分，评估了11个ImageNet预训练模型和两个从头训练的模型（一个紧凑的自定义网络和MobileNetV3-L）。在未见过的对象上，最佳预训练模型达到了98.8%的宏平均F1分数，且有六个模型在统计上并列。随机划分将从头训练模型的准确率高估了15至19个百分点。从头训练的模型还漏检了11%至13%的医疗物品，而预训练模型的漏检率低于1%。在来自达卡的第二份数据集上，预训练模型的准确率下降了15至22个百分点。因此，分类器应在未见过的对象上进行评估，随机划分的结果应视为上限。数据位于Zenodo，代码位于https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

papers.title: Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
papers.translated_title: 回复前重放：面向统一多模态编码的第二眼提示
papers.author: Yicheng Zhang
papers.summary: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.
papers.translated_summary: 解决多模态任务需要视觉语言模型（VLM）对图像和问题文本形成统一理解。然而，在当前VLM的因果注意力机制下，一个token只能关注其前面的内容。因此，无论哪种模态排在前面，都是在仅观察到部分输入的情况下被编码的，无法获知多模态上下文的其余部分。我们提出Second-Look Prompting（SLP），一种无需训练的方法，在输入中重复图像-问题对。在重复的副本中，每个视觉和文本token都能关注到完整输入，从而产生该对的统一多模态编码。此外，新增的视觉token所带来的计算贡献不止于重新暴露图像：即使在其位置放置一张空白图像也能提升推理效果。在12个基准测试上，SLP提升了每个被评估模型的总体平均得分，涵盖九个开源模型（3B-72B）和三个专有前沿模型，其中Gemini 3 Flash在MATH-Vision上的提升达到5.6分。我们的分析揭示了两个互补机制：问题引导第二张图像关注何处，而新增的视觉token充当预填充草稿本，其隐藏状态保留了来自图像和问题的答案相关信息。这些发现凸显了输入呈现方式作为提升VLM性能的一种简单而有效的途径。

papers.title: DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation
papers.translated_title: DexLatentWorld：面向零样本机器人操作的3D跨具身潜在动作世界模型
papers.author: Vinay Udit Mohan
papers.summary: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM's reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.
papers.translated_summary: 世界模型通过使智能体能够预判其行为的后果，从而促进机器人操作中的规划与控制。然而，这些模型通常依赖于带有动作标签的交互数据，而此类数据获取成本高昂且难以规模化。这些模型还往往与其训练时所基于的特定具身形态绑定，限制了向此前未见过的机器人形态的可迁移性。我们提出了一种三维潜在动作世界模型，它直接从重定向后的人类操作演示的点云观测中学习连续动作表示。采用对比目标来鼓励跨具身形态的一致运动表示。由此得到的统一潜在动作空间直接作为模型预测控制的搜索空间，其中采样的潜在动作作为基于粒子的未来预测的条件。随后，可执行的机器人命令从预测的几何运动中恢复出来，而无需特定于具身形态的动作解码器。通过大量评估，我们证明所学习的潜在动作表现出可控且可组合的运动，能够迁移到未见过的机器人具身形态，并支持具有未见过的夹爪几何形状的零样本操作。经过任务无关的适应后，我们的模型在到达、抓取和放置任务上分别达到90%、92%和60%的成功率，而DexWM报告的成功率分别为72%、58%和28%。最后，我们展示了使用未见过的灵巧手进行零样本真实世界操作，在涉及推动、抓取和提起日常物体的五项多样任务上，50次试验中达到86%的成功率。这些结果凸显了基于几何的潜在动作作为基于世界模型的机器人操作的统一、可迁移接口的潜力。项目材料，包括演示视频和源代码，可在 https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/ 获取。

papers.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
papers.translated_title: GlanceNav：具有流式记忆与反事实回溯的高效视觉-语言导航
papers.author: Anh Dao
papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已成为视觉与语言导航（VLN）的有力策略。然而，大多数模型在每次决策时都会重新编码过去帧的样本，并且在孤立的决策上训练，因此计算冗余且可用历史很短。它们还通过结果奖励从自身错误中学习，而结果奖励为整个回合只给出一个标量。我们提出疑问：导航器能否以每步恒定成本仅对每一帧编码一次，同时仍能记住关键信息并高效地从错误中学习？我们提出 GlanceNav，一种基于混合 MLLM 的流式导航器。其门控 DeltaNet 层在整个回合中携带循环状态，而注意力层保留近期观测的短窗口和一个小型关键帧库，关键帧根据每帧对循环状态的改变程度选取。这种恒定大小的记忆使每步成本固定，并允许在与推理相同的内存条件下对整个回合进行训练。由于整个记忆还可以在恒定时间内复制，我们进一步提出反事实回卷（CoRe），一个强化学习阶段，它将漂移的 rollout 回卷到其最接近目标的时刻，让专家纠正少量动作，并根据结果的变化来归因决策。仅在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 训练集上训练，并使用 1,000 条指令进行强化学习，一个 4B 的 GlanceNav 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE val-unseen 上分别达到 71.9% 和 73.6% 的成功率。在 R2R-CE 上，它比之前未使用外部数据训练的最强单 RGB 方法高出 9.1 个百分点，同时以每步 104 毫秒运行。

papers.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
papers.translated_title: 世界模型作为原生潜在动作模型
papers.author: Qinyue Li
papers.summary: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.
papers.translated_summary: 大规模且多样的视频来源，例如第一人称人类视频和异构机器人记录，携带丰富的动力学信息，但要么没有动作，要么没有共享的动作空间。潜在动作模型（LAMs）可以恢复这些动力学，但它们从头训练其逆动力学和正向动力学模型（IDM、FDM），在像素重建与潜在容量和准确性之间进行权衡。预训练视频世界模型原生生成高保真动力学，但以密集方式表示它们，在所有层中纠缠在一起。将世界模型视为LAM，我们表明可以通过对模型进行最小改动来提取这些动力学。Native LAM将一个预训练视频扩散变换器同时用作IDM和FDM，可学习的动力学寄存器作为两者之间唯一的因果桥梁，并在仅运动不同的反事实时间对上训练，使得寄存器将视频的动力学蒸馏为紧凑的native潜在动作。我们进一步提出一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的预训练范式，即从世界模型预训练动作（PAWlicy），其中Native LAM在大规模视频上充当动力学教师；与世界动作模型不同，它从不生成视频。Native潜在动作在LARY基准上在动作分类和控制回归方面均优于现有LAMs，并在新机器人、新场景以及从人手到机器人上重放相同运动，尽管训练中未使用任何迁移目标。使用3.8B模型，PAWlicy在使用域随机化演示训练的RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%的平均成功率，在VLAs中最高。在RoboDojo上，它在我们评估的每个维度上都具有竞争力，并且我们评估的其Precision与领先的排行榜条目相当。在真实机器人上，它在两个任务上均优于pi_0.5基线。两个阶段仅使用公开数据和公开释放的世界模型。

papers.title: Predicting Rare-Mode Collapse in Recursive Generative Training from Single-Generation Calibration
papers.translated_title: 从单代校准预测递归生成训练中的稀有模式崩溃
papers.author: Jingyao Zhang
papers.summary: Recursive generative training can preserve sample counts in a rare region while silently eroding its characteristic core. Mapping this finite-horizon collapse across real-data quotas, rare prevalences, and feedback perturbations via exhaustive multi-generation chains is computationally prohibitive. We develop a decoupled framework that forecasts multi-generation collapse probabilities and locates operating risk boundaries from independent single-generation conditional fits alone. Pairing an exact three-source multinomial count law with single-generation response banks propagates count marginals in closed form, backed by explicit calibration-error and boundary-resolution bounds. For additive Gaussian perturbations, we further prove that equal-variance all-row and sparse policies reverse their boundary-crossing order at a unique hyperplane distance. Across a 2,178-setting count benchmark, exact propagation cuts risk mean absolute error (MAE) from 1.85 to 0.49 percentage points (pp). Across ten two-dimensional learners, calibration achieves 2.60--5.69~pp six-round core MAE on nine stationary learners (65--81\% below an unperturbed baseline), diagnoses non-stationary outlier drift in standard DDIM (16.38~pp) via a stability probe, and resolves the predicted six-round geometric reversal. On Fashion-MNIST latent flow-matching chains, calibration outperforms direct-chain Gaussian-process interpolation at lower fit budgets and tracks the 20\% latent-perturbation boundary shift (3.14 versus 10.78~pp MAE for proportion copying) driven by opposing inflow to the rare region and outflow from its core.
papers.translated_summary: 递归生成训练可以在稀有区域保持样本数量，同时悄然侵蚀其特征核心。通过穷举多代链将这种有限时域崩溃映射到真实数据配额、稀有流行率和反馈扰动上在计算上是不可行的。我们开发了一个解耦框架，仅从独立的单代条件拟合中预测多代崩溃概率并定位操作风险边界。将精确的三源多项计数定律与单代响应库配对，以闭式形式传播计数边缘分布，并有明确的校准误差和边界分辨率界限作为支撑。对于加性高斯扰动，我们进一步证明等方差全行策略和稀疏策略在唯一的超平面距离处反转其边界穿越顺序。在涵盖2,178种设置的计数基准上，精确传播将风险平均绝对误差（MAE）从1.85个百分点（pp）降至0.49个百分点。在十个二维学习器上，校准在九个平稳学习器上实现了2.60--5.69~pp的六轮核心MAE（比未扰动基线低65--81%），通过稳定性探针诊断出标准DDIM中的非平稳异常漂移（16.38~pp），并解决了预测的六轮几何反转。在Fashion-MNIST潜在流匹配链上，校准在较低的拟合预算下优于直接链高斯过程插值，并跟踪由稀有区域的相反流入和其核心的流出驱动的20%潜在扰动边界偏移（比例复制为3.14对10.78~pp MAE）。

papers.title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
papers.translated_title: 看到就说：主动式任务助手应等待证据，而非时钟
papers.author: Bohe Chen
papers.summary: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.
papers.translated_summary: 主动助手在引导人们完成物理任务时，必须每隔几秒判断一个步骤是否完成以及是否发生了错误。我们发现，该任务的两个基准在很大程度上奖励的是知道何时而非看到什么：一个从不查看视频的计时器，在25秒时发出警报，并在30秒时确认每个步骤，在Ego-MC-Bench上达到0.373的错误F1，高于所有已发表结果（最高为0.27）。我们将此形式化为视频盲前沿，即策略仅凭经过时间、指令和训练统计所能达到的完成准确率与错误F1之间的最佳权衡：Ego-MC-Bench上所有已发表的逐步结果都位于其内，我们在QICD上运行的全部十二个零样本模型也是如此。为了超越这一前沿，我们引入了证据对比训练（ECT）：在基准自身的问题上进行微调，并将其正例与来自同一录制、同一经过时间的负例配对，使经过时间无法区分一对中的两侧。在约15个GPU小时内于209个QICD视频上训练，一个带有ECT的2B模型在两个基准上均在全部四个种子中跨越了前沿；在没有适应的情况下迁移到Ego-MC-Bench，它及时确认了59%的无错误步骤，而一个具有相同骨干、在约25k合成反事实和真实录制上训练的已发表模型为30%。其决策超越了计时所能解释的范围而跟随视频：在相同经过时间下，它在90-92%的测试对中区分已完成步骤与未完成步骤，而指令的典型时长达到65%，在帧之间重新缩放时间戳使其基本不变，而换入另一段录制（在存在的情况下为同一配方的录制）则使其完成准确率下降三分之二。代码和模型权重将公开发布。

papers.title: Useful but Unwieldy: How Software Engineers Perceive the Design of Chain-of-Thought Explanations in Coding Agents
papers.translated_title: 有用但笨重：软件工程师如何看待编码智能体中思维链解释的设计
papers.author: Carlos Rafael Catalan
papers.summary: Coding agents (CAs) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering (SE) workflows. As these CAs take up more tasks and responsibilities, it is imperative for software engineers to understand the CA's rationale behind its' decisions, also known as the chain-of-thought (CoT). During the interaction, some CAs are capable of showing this CoT as a separate message to users with the goal of providing transparency and explainability. However, its effectiveness as an explainable AI (XAI) mechanism for end-users in software engineering has not yet been established in the literature. This motivates us to understand their experiences with the CoT message as an XAI tool through a survey and semi-structured follow-up interviews with 36 software engineers. Through thematic analysis of the survey responses and interview transcripts, we found that CoT message is an indispensable tool for software engineers in terms of transparency, scrutability, and trust towards the CA. However, various instances of CoT messages being overly verbose, containing technical information that does not match the users' expertise, or being perceived by the users as ``detached'' from the conversation because the ``agent is talking to itself'', lead to comprehension difficulties and selective use or abandonment of the tool. We synthesize these insights to inform the design of CoT messages that support software engineers in their explainability needs.
papers.translated_summary: 由大型语言模型驱动的编码智能体正日益融入软件工程工作流程。随着这些编码智能体承担更多任务与职责，软件工程师必须理解其决策背后的理据，即思维链。在交互过程中，部分编码智能体能够将这一思维链作为单独消息展示给用户，以提供透明性与可解释性。然而，其作为面向软件工程终端用户的可解释人工智能机制的有效性，在文献中尚未得到确立。这促使我们通过一项调查及对36名软件工程师的半结构化后续访谈，来理解他们将思维链消息作为可解释人工智能工具的使用体验。通过对调查回答与访谈记录的主题分析，我们发现思维链消息在透明性、可审查性以及对编码智能体的信任方面，是软件工程师不可或缺的工具。然而，思维链消息存在多种问题，如过于冗长、包含与用户专业水平不匹配的技术信息，或因“智能体在自言自语”而被用户认为与对话“脱节”，这些情况导致理解困难以及对该工具的选择性使用或弃用。我们综合这些见解，为设计支持软件工程师可解释性需求的思维链消息提供参考。

papers.title: Chronic evoked seizures differentially worsen cognitive function and long-term neuropsychiatric comorbidities in Alzheimer's disease-related genotypes
papers.translated_title: 慢性诱发性癫痫发作对阿尔茨海默病相关基因型中的认知功能和长期神经精神共病具有差异性恶化作用
papers.author: Knox, K.
papers.summary: Variants in one of three deterministic risk genes - amyloid precursor protein (APP), presenilin 1 (PSEN1), or presenilin 2 (PSEN2) - lead to early-onset Alzheimer's disease (EOAD), which also carries a high risk of spontaneous seizures. Seizures may worsen AD-related behavioral comorbidities, including depression, anxiety, and cognitive impairment. Using the corneal kindling model of secondarily generalized focal seizures in two distinct aged male and female EOAD-associated mouse models, we assessed the interaction between investigator-initiated chronic seizures and EOAD genotype on AD-related behavioral comorbidities. Genotypes were selected to model amyloid-b; independent and dependent AD risk factors and included: PSEN2-N141I (amyloid-b; independent model) versus wild-type (PSEN2 control) mice, and APP/PS1 (amyloid-b dependent model) versus wild-type littermates (Tg-). Sham and fully kindled mice then underwent behavioral assessment in the saccharin preference test of anhedonia-like behavior, the Barnes maze test of spatial learning and memory, and a 67-hour home cage monitoring of circadian activity. EOAD genotype only significantly affected kindling acquisition of aged APP/PS1 females. However, there was no significant genotype or kindling effect on saccharin preference, suggesting no adverse impact on anhedonia-like behavior. Cognitive performance in the Barnes maze was significantly worsened by seizures exclusively in APP/PS1 female mice. However, seizures generally worsened Barnes maze performance of male PSEN2-N141I and PSEN2 control mice. Finally, chronic seizures consistently worsened exploratory behavior patterns during home cage circadian activity monitoring exclusively in APP/PS1 male and female mice. This study reveals the AD-related heterogeneity of seizure-evoked behavioral consequences on spatial working memory and circadian behaviors.
papers.translated_summary: 三个确定性风险基因——淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）、早老素1（PSEN1）或早老素2（PSEN2）——中的任一基因变异均可导致早发性阿尔茨海默病（EOAD），该病同时具有自发性癫痫发作的高风险。癫痫发作可能加重AD相关的行为共病，包括抑郁、焦虑和认知障碍。本研究采用角膜点燃模型诱导继发性全面性局灶性癫痫发作，在两种不同的老年雄性和雌性EOAD相关小鼠模型中，评估研究者诱发的慢性癫痫发作与EOAD基因型之间的交互作用对AD相关行为共病的影响。基因型的选择旨在模拟淀粉样蛋白β非依赖性和依赖性的AD风险因素，包括：PSEN2-N141I（淀粉样蛋白β非依赖模型）与野生型（PSEN2对照）小鼠，以及APP/PS1（淀粉样蛋白β依赖模型）与野生型同窝对照（Tg-）小鼠。假点燃组和完全点燃组小鼠随后接受行为学评估，包括糖精偏好测试（快感缺失样行为）、Barnes迷宫测试（空间学习与记忆）以及67小时家庭笼昼夜活动监测。EOAD基因型仅显著影响老年APP/PS1雌性小鼠的点燃获得过程。然而，基因型或点燃对糖精偏好均无显著影响，提示对快感缺失样行为无不良影响。Barnes迷宫中的认知表现仅在接受癫痫发作的APP/PS1雌性小鼠中显著恶化。然而，癫痫发作普遍恶化了雄性PSEN2-N141I和PSEN2对照小鼠的Barnes迷宫表现。最后，慢性癫痫发作一致性地恶化了家庭笼昼夜活动监测中的探索行为模式，且这一效应仅见于APP/PS1雄性和雌性小鼠。本研究揭示了癫痫发作诱发的空间工作记忆和昼夜行为行为后果在AD相关方面的异质性。

papers.title: Identification of a human Anxa1-associated dopaminergic population linked to Parkinson's disease vulnerability and sensorimotor putaminal networks
papers.translated_title: 人类Anxa1相关多巴胺能群体的鉴定及其与帕金森病易感性和感觉运动壳核网络的关联
papers.author: Schonfeld, E.
papers.summary: The selective loss of dopaminergic (DA) neurons drives motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease (PD). In mice, Anxa1+ SNc DA neurons are highly vulnerable in PD models, project to the dorsolateral striatum, and display movement-correlated activity, yet they lack clearly defined human counterparts. We transfer the mouse taxonomy to human using a hierarchical mixture-of-experts model, recovering a human Anxa1-associated population. We find that this was the most depleted subtype in PD brains. A ligand-receptor algorithm, validated against mouse tracing, infers that these neurons preferentially innervate the caudal putamen. There, DaT-SPECT shows the earliest and most severe DA axon loss in PD. Functional connectivity positions this region as a critical node within the somato-cognitive action network, linking DA neuron vulnerability to circuit dysfunction. To translate these insights, we present an interactive portal unifying human datasets with a cross-species FDA Drug Atlas, nominating CACNA1G as a candidate neuroprotective target for the Anxa1-associated population.
papers.translated_summary: 多巴胺能（DA）神经元的选择性丢失驱动帕金森病（PD）的运动症状。在小鼠中，Anxa1+ SNc DA神经元在PD模型中高度脆弱，投射至背外侧纹状体，并表现出与运动相关的活动，但它们缺乏明确界定的人类对应物。我们使用分层混合专家模型将小鼠分类学转移至人类，恢复出一个人类Anxa1相关群体。我们发现这是PD大脑中耗竭最严重的亚型。一种配体-受体算法经小鼠示踪验证，推断这些神经元优先支配尾侧壳核。在该区域，DaT-SPECT显示PD中最早且最严重的DA轴突丢失。功能连接将该区域定位为躯体-认知行动网络中的关键节点，将DA神经元脆弱性与环路功能障碍联系起来。为转化这些见解，我们呈现一个交互式门户，将人类数据集与跨物种FDA药物图谱统一起来，提名CACNA1G作为Anxa1相关群体的候选神经保护靶点。

papers.title: The language network responds stronger to connected than to unconnected sentences
papers.translated_title: 语言网络对连贯句子的反应比对不连贯句子的反应更强
papers.author: Paliga, F.
papers.summary: Purpose: Reliable functional mapping of the language network and preoperative assessment of language lateralization are essential for safe and effective craniotomy in patients with lesions in language-eloquent brain regions, yet existing fMRI language paradigms are often time-consuming and place substantial cognitive and economic demands on patients and diagnostic services. Methods: We therefore tested ecologically valid German stimulus sets designed to optimize measurement efficiency. Forty-three healthy participants (mean age = 38 years, range = 20 - 64; 24 women) were scanned on a 3T MRI while reading or listening to 4-, 8-, and 12-word sentences and pseudoword lists or texts, each followed by a decision task. Sentences were selected from German literary classics and text passages from general-interest science magazines and matched across conditions for lexical and structural properties. Results: Region-of-interest analyses in subject-specific, functionally defined language-sensitive regions showed robust activation of the left-hemispheric language network across modalities. Within participants, texts elicited significantly larger effect sizes than sentences, and longer sentences generally produced stronger responses than shorter ones. Task manipulations expected to increase cognitive demand (short 4-word sentences with frequent probes, coherent texts requiring deeper semantic integration) did not enhance responses in the domain-general multiple demand network, indicating that executive-control activity did not overshadow language-selective activation, whereas substantial overlap between default mode and language-sensitive regions in the left temporal lobe was consistent with relatively automatic processing of connected language. Conclusions: These findings indicate that ecologically valid sentence- and text-based paradigms can provide efficient, language-specific fMRI protocols for preoperative diagnostics and individualized presurgical planning in patients with lesions near language-eloquent cortex.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：可靠的语言网络功能定位和术前语言偏侧化评估对于语言功能区病变患者的安全有效开颅手术至关重要，然而现有的fMRI语言范式往往耗时较长，并对患者和诊断服务造成较大的认知和经济负担。方法：因此，我们测试了生态有效的德语刺激集，旨在优化测量效率。43名健康参与者（平均年龄=38岁，范围=20-64岁；24名女性）在3T MRI上接受扫描，期间阅读或聆听4词、8词和12词句子及假词列表或文本，每项任务后跟随一个判断任务。句子选自德国文学经典，文本段落选自大众兴趣科学杂志，并在各条件间对词汇和结构属性进行了匹配。结果：在被试特异性、功能定义的语言敏感区域进行感兴趣区分析显示，左半球语言网络在各模态下均出现稳健激活。在被试内，文本引发的效应量显著大于句子，较长的句子通常比较短的句子产生更强的反应。预期增加认知需求的任务操作（带有频繁探测的短4词句子、需要更深语义整合的连贯文本）并未增强域一般多重需求网络的反应，表明执行控制活动未掩盖语言选择性激活，而左颞叶默认模式区域与语言敏感区域之间的显著重叠与连贯语言的相对自动加工相一致。结论：这些发现表明，生态有效的句子和文本范式可为语言功能区皮层附近病变患者的术前诊断和个体化术前规划提供高效、语言特异性的fMRI方案。

papers.title: Preparatory beta activity reflects the precision demands of an upcoming movement
papers.translated_title: 预备性β活动反映了即将发生的动作对精确度的要求
papers.author: Delisle-Godin, D.
papers.summary: Noise and external disturbances continuously push the limb away from its intended path, but not every deviation compromises the goal of an action. The accuracy constraints of a task define the range of acceptable endpoints and thereby set its precision demands, that is, how much noise must be attenuated for the task to succeed. Whether neural activity during movement preparation reflects these precision demands remains largely unexplored. We recorded electroencephalography (EEG) while healthy human participants (n = 27) prepared reaching movements toward narrow or wide targets at the same location and with the same timing constraints. An instructed delay before the go cue allowed preparatory activity to be isolated, and mechanical perturbations were applied during movement to probe feedback responses. Narrow targets led to more precise movements, with greater endpoint accuracy, lower variability and smaller perturbation-induced deviations. This was achieved without a reduction in movement speed, and involved greater muscle co-activation and larger long-latency responses to perturbations. Before movement onset, beta power (13-30 Hz) was lower for narrow than for wide targets, an effect that emerged late in the delay period and was concentrated over bilateral parieto-occipital electrodes. In contrast, alpha (8-12 Hz) and theta (4-7 Hz) activity did not differ between conditions. These findings demonstrate that preparatory beta activity is sensitive not only to kinematic requirements of the movement but also the precision with which it must be produced.
papers.translated_summary: 噪声和外部扰动不断使肢体偏离其预定路径，但并非每一次偏差都会损害动作的目标。任务的精度约束定义了可接受终点的范围，从而设定了其精度需求，即为使任务成功需要衰减多少噪声。运动准备期间的神经活动是否反映这些精度需求，在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们记录了健康人类参与者（n = 27）的脑电图（EEG），他们在相同位置、相同时间约束下准备朝向窄目标或宽目标的伸够运动。在提示信号之前的指令延迟使准备性活动得以被分离，并在运动期间施加机械扰动以探测反馈反应。窄目标导致更精确的运动，具有更高的终点精度、更低的变异性和更小的扰动诱发偏差。这是在运动速度未降低的情况下实现的，并涉及更大的肌肉共激活和对扰动的更大长潜伏期反应。在运动开始之前，窄目标的beta功率（13-30 Hz）低于宽目标，该效应在延迟期后期出现，并集中于双侧顶枕电极。相比之下，alpha（8-12 Hz）和theta（4-7 Hz）活动在两种条件之间没有差异。这些发现表明，准备性beta活动不仅对运动的运动学要求敏感，而且对其必须被产生的精度也敏感。

papers.title: Intranasal oxytocin increases early tactile engagement with a robotic dog: A within-session effect without consolidation
papers.translated_title: 鼻内催产素增加与机器狗的早期触觉互动：一种无巩固的会话内效应
papers.author: Aydin, S.
papers.summary: Oxytocin (OXT) is centrally involved in mammalian affiliation, but whether it modulates affiliative behavior toward artificial social agents, and how such an effect unfolds within a single interaction, is unclear. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo (PLA)-controlled study, 61 healthy adult males received 40 IU intranasal OXT or PLA before interacting with a Sony aibo robotic dog across an initial free interaction, a cooperative task-learning phase, and a final free interaction, with ten affiliative behaviors coded from video. OXT increased tactile engagement early: participants touched aibo longer during the initial free interaction, the only outcome of ten to survive family-wise correction. A weaker increase in smile frequency did not survive correction, and instrumental behavior was unaffected. Contrary to our second prediction, the advantage was not consolidated: it held through the initial interaction, closed across the intervening task, and was absent at the final one. An exploratory decomposition located the effect: participants under OXT did not initiate contact more often, and the difference was carried by how long each episode of contact was sustained. Urinary OXT confirmed group-level exposure. Because the design included no comparison condition and confounded interaction period with elapsed time and pharmacokinetics, it cannot establish bond formation, robot specificity, or consolidation as a psychological process. What it does bound is where and when OXT acted: on the maintenance of contact rather than its initiation, and only while the agent was novel, a pattern that fits salience- and novelty-based accounts better than bond formation.
papers.translated_summary: 催产素（OXT）在哺乳动物的亲社会联结中发挥核心作用，但它是否调节对人工社会主体的亲和行为，以及这种效应在单次互动中如何展开，尚不清楚。在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂（PLA）对照研究中，61名健康成年男性在与索尼aibo机器狗互动前接受40 IU鼻内OXT或PLA，互动包括初始自由互动、合作任务学习阶段和最终自由互动，并从视频中编码十种亲和行为。OXT在早期增加了触觉参与：参与者在初始自由互动中触摸aibo的时间更长，这是十项结果中唯一经家庭wise校正后仍显著的结果。微笑频率的较弱增加未通过校正，工具性行为未受影响。与我们的第二个预测相反，该优势并未得到巩固：它在初始互动中持续存在，在中间任务期间消失，在最终互动中不存在。一项探索性分解定位了该效应：接受OXT的参与者并未更频繁地发起接触，差异由每次接触 episode 的持续时间所承载。尿液OXT证实了组水平暴露。由于设计未包含对照条件，且将互动时段与流逝时间和药代动力学相混淆，它无法确立联结形成、机器人特异性或巩固作为一种心理过程。它所能界定的是OXT作用的位置和时间：作用于接触的维持而非发起，且仅在主体新颖时，这一模式更符合基于显著性和新颖性的解释，而非联结形成。

papers.title: Reduced subcortical envelope phase locking in middle age without detectable changes in perceptual discrimination
papers.translated_title: 中年期皮层下包络相位锁定减弱，但知觉辨别无可检测变化
papers.author: Lopez-Ramos, D.
papers.summary: Cochlear synaptopathy (CS) can occur during normal aging without elevated audiometric thresholds and has been hypothesized to contribute to suprathreshold auditory difficulties. Frequency-following responses (FFRs) have been proposed as markers of CS, but whether their envelope- and temporal-fine-structure-related components are similarly affected by age, and whether such changes relate to perceptual sensitivity, remains unclear. Here, we examined associations between age-related FFR changes and perceptual sensitivity in young (n = 20, 19-32 years) and middle-aged (n = 20, 40-58 years) adults with clinically normal hearing. Participants completed psychoacoustic discrimination tasks for formant frequency, formant bandwidth, and temporal-envelope shape using stationary stimuli in quiet and background noise. FFRs were recorded using dynamic stimuli varying along the same acoustic dimensions. We quantified envelope- and temporal-fine-structure-related phase locking (PLVENV and PLVTFS) across harmonics and assessed how it tracked stimulus changes over time. Mean PLVENV decreased significantly with age, and PLVENV tracking of decreasing formant bandwidth and temporal-envelope shape weakened with age. In contrast, mean PLVTFS and temporal slopes of PLVTFS spectral centroid were not significantly associated with age. Discrimination thresholds showed no significant associations with age, either in quiet or in noise, and PLV measures did not significantly explain individual differences in discrimination thresholds. These findings indicate that age-related reductions in subcortical envelope phase locking can be detected by middle age without corresponding measurable reductions in perceptual sensitivity.
papers.translated_summary: 耳蜗突触病变（CS）可在正常衰老过程中发生，而不伴随听阈升高，并被认为可能导致超阈值听觉困难。频率跟随反应（FFR）已被提出作为CS的标志物，但其包络相关成分和时间精细结构相关成分是否同样受年龄影响，以及这些变化是否与感知敏感性相关，仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们考察了临床听力正常的年轻成人（n = 20，19-32岁）和中年成人（n = 20，40-58岁）中年龄相关FFR变化与感知敏感性之间的关联。参与者完成了针对共振峰频率、共振峰带宽和时间包络形状的心理声学辨别任务，使用安静和背景噪声中的稳态刺激。FFR使用沿相同声学维度变化的动态刺激记录。我们量化了跨谐波的包络相关和时间精细结构相关的相位锁定（PLVENV和PLVTFS），并评估其如何随时间追踪刺激变化。平均PLVENV随年龄显著下降，且PLVENV对递减共振峰带宽和时间包络形状的追踪随年龄减弱。相比之下，平均PLVTFS及PLVTFS频谱质心的时间斜率与年龄无显著关联。辨别阈值在安静或噪声条件下均未显示与年龄的显著关联，且PLV指标未能显著解释辨别阈值的个体差异。这些发现表明，亚皮层包络相位锁定的年龄相关下降可在中年被检测到，而不伴随可测量的感知敏感性相应下降。

papers.title: Terminally differentiated CX3CR1+ natural killer cells drive coronary arteritis through an NFAT-T-bet axis
papers.translated_title: 终末分化的CX3CR1+自然杀伤细胞通过NFAT-T-bet轴驱动冠状动脉炎
papers.author: Fujita, M.
papers.summary: Natural killer (NK) cells acquire potent effector function through terminal differentiation, yet the signals driving this program toward pathogenicity in vascular inflammation remain undefined. Using an FK565-induced mouse model of Kawasaki disease and single-cell transcriptomics from patients, we identify NK cells as major drivers of coronary arteritis through cytotoxicity and CCL5-CCR1-mediated recruitment of myeloid cells. This activity is concentrated in a terminally differentiated, T-bet-driven NK cell subset, the cardiac accumulation of which depends on CX3CR1, and a corresponding population is enriched in patient transcriptomic datasets. We further identify signaling through calcineurin and nuclear factor of activated T cells (NFAT) as an upstream driver of this program, with NFATc1 induced in NK cells. Calcineurin inhibition suppressed T-bet induction, reduced this subset and attenuated disease development. These findings define an NFAT-T-bet-CX3CR1 axis that couples terminal NK cell differentiation to coronary inflammation.
papers.translated_summary: 自然杀伤（NK）细胞通过终末分化获得强效效应功能，然而在血管炎症中驱动该程序走向致病性的信号仍不明确。利用FK565诱导的川崎病小鼠模型以及来自患者的单细胞转录组学，我们确定NK细胞是通过细胞毒作用以及CCL5-CCR1介导的髓系细胞募集来驱动冠状动脉炎的主要因素。该活性集中于一个终末分化的、由T-bet驱动的NK细胞亚群，其心脏蓄积依赖于CX3CR1，并且相应的人群在患者转录组数据集中富集。我们进一步确定通过钙调神经磷酸酶和活化T细胞核因子（NFAT）的信号传导是该程序的上游驱动因素，其中NFATc1在NK细胞中被诱导。钙调神经磷酸酶抑制抑制了T-bet诱导，减少了该亚群并减弱了疾病发展。这些发现定义了一个NFAT-T-bet-CX3CR1轴，将NK细胞终末分化与冠状动脉炎症偶联起来。

papers.title: Dynamic T-cell receptor repertoire remodeling is associated with murine and human lung allograft dysfunction
papers.translated_title: 动态T细胞受体库重塑与小鼠和人类肺移植功能障碍相关
papers.author: Wang, Y.
papers.summary: Chronic lung allograft dysfunction (CLAD) is a major cause of late graft failure after lung transplantation. Acute cellular rejection is an established risk factor for CLAD. However, its diagnosis by biopsy may incompletely capture dynamic and spatially heterogeneous immune remodeling within the allograft. We investigated whether lung graft proximal T-cell receptor beta-chain (TCR{beta}) repertoire features reflect alloimmune remodeling and associate with acute cellular rejection (ACR) and CLAD. TCR{beta}; sequencing was performed on graft-infiltrating T-cells from a murine orthotopic lung transplant model and on 90 longitudinal bronchoalveolar lavage cell-pellet (BAL-cp) samples from 23 lung transplant recipients during the first post-transplant year. In the murine model, allografts showed persistent histologic injury and strong, consistent TCR{beta}; repertoire remodeling relative to isografts. Across days 28 and 56, murine allografts had higher productive clonality (Cliff's {delta}; = 0.93, p = 0.0087) and maximum productive frequency (Cliff's {delta}; = 0.93, p = 0.014), with complete rank separation at each time point. Murine allografts also exhibited greater pairwise Morisita repertoire overlap (p < 0.0001) and enrichment of recurrent, high-frequency shared clonotypes. Productive clonality from human lung transplant recipients' BAL-cp was higher at the a priori selected month-6 visit from patients who developed CLAD, as compared to those who remained CLAD-free (p = 0.0326). In a month-6 surveillance-visit index analysis, high productive clonality was associated with early onset CLAD (CLAD within 2 years of transplant) (log-rank p = 0.038). In a patient-specific index-event analysis, CLAD-free survival differed across high and low productive clonality groups among acute rejectors (log-rank p = 0.019). Together, these findings establish measurable graft-localized TCR{beta}; repertoire remodeling and position BAL TCR{beta}; profiling as a potential complement to biopsy diagnosis. With validation in larger cohorts, graft-proximal repertoire measures may help identify CLAD-associated immune states before the onset of lung function decline and inform more individualized surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 慢性肺移植物功能障碍（CLAD）是肺移植后晚期移植物衰竭的主要原因。急性细胞排斥反应是CLAD的既定危险因素。然而，通过活检诊断可能无法完全捕捉移植物内动态且空间异质性的免疫重塑。我们研究了肺移植物近端T细胞受体β链（TCR{beta}） repertoire特征是否反映同种免疫重塑，并与急性细胞排斥反应（ACR）和CLAD相关。对小鼠原位肺移植模型的移植物浸润T细胞以及23名肺移植受者移植后第一年内90份纵向支气管肺泡灌洗细胞沉淀（BAL-cp）样本进行了TCR{beta}测序。在小鼠模型中，与同种移植物相比，同种异体移植物显示出持续的组织学损伤和强烈、一致的TCR{beta} repertoire重塑。在第28天和第56天，小鼠同种异体移植物具有更高的生产性克隆性（Cliff's {delta} = 0.93，p = 0.0087）和最大生产性频率（Cliff's {delta} = 0.93，p = 0.014），在每个时间点均具有完全的秩分离。小鼠同种异体移植物还表现出更大的成对Morisita repertoire重叠（p < 0.0001）以及复发性高频共享克隆型的富集。与保持无CLAD的患者相比，发展为CLAD的患者在预先选择的第6个月访视时，人肺移植受者BAL-cp的生产性克隆性更高（p = 0.0326）。在第6个月监测访视指数分析中，高生产性克隆性与早发性CLAD（移植后2年内发生CLAD）相关（log-rank p = 0.038）。在患者特异性指数事件分析中，急性排斥者中高和低生产性克隆性组的无CLAD生存率存在差异（log-rank p = 0.019）。总之，这些发现确立了可测量的移植物局部TCR{beta} repertoire重塑，并将BAL TCR{beta}谱分析定位为活检诊断的潜在补充。随着在更大队列中的验证，移植物近端repertoire测量可能有助于在肺功能下降发生之前识别与CLAD相关的免疫状态，并为更个体化的监测提供信息。

papers.title: A Conserved Interface Between COG4 and Syntaxin 5 Is Essential for Intra-Golgi Membrane Trafficking
papers.translated_title: COG4与Syntaxin 5之间一个保守的界面对于高尔基体内膜运输至关重要
papers.author: Neetole, S. T.
papers.summary: The conserved oligomeric Golgi (COG) complex tethers retrograde intra-Golgi transport vesicles, but how it engages the SNARE machinery to support vesicle fusion remains unclear. Here, we identify a functional interface between the COG subunit COG4 and the Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5 (STX5). The C-terminal region of COG4 coprecipitated with STX5, and AlphaFold3 modeling placed the COG4 MUN-C-like subdomain in contact with the STX5 Ha-Hb loop and the linker connecting its Habc domain to the SNARE motif. Replacing the Ha-Hb loop with a flexible Gly/Ser sequence preserved STX5 localization and its interaction with SCFD1 but impaired rescue of GPP130 abundance and protein glycosylation in STX5-depleted cells. Combining the loop replacement with linker substitutions reduced recovery of COG3 and the SNARE partner GS15 with STX5 and led to vesicle accumulation around disorganized Golgi cisternae. On the COG4 side of the interface with Qa-SNARE, alanine substitution of the conserved residues D452 and D453 reduced coprecipitation with STX5. Replacing these residues with either alanine or lysine preserved COG4 localization and COG8 recruitment to the Golgi but failed to restore normal glycosylation, GS15 localization, or altered Golgi morphology in COG4-knockout cells. These findings support a model in which the COG4-STX5 interface couples vesicle tethering to productive SNARE assembly, thereby controlling vesicular retrograde trafficking and Golgi organization.
papers.translated_summary: 保守寡聚高尔基体（COG）复合体将逆向高尔基体内运输囊泡系连，但其如何与SNARE机制接合以支持囊泡融合仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了COG亚基COG4与Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5（STX5）之间的功能性界面。COG4的C端区域与STX5共沉淀，AlphaFold3建模显示COG4的MUN-C样亚结构域与STX5的Ha-Hb环以及连接其Habc结构域与SNARE基序的连接区相接触。将Ha-Hb环替换为柔性Gly/Ser序列可保持STX5定位及其与SCFD1的相互作用，但削弱了在STX5缺失细胞中对GPP130丰度和蛋白质糖基化的挽救。将环替换与连接区替换相结合，降低了COG3和SNARE伙伴GS15与STX5的回收，并导致囊泡在紊乱的高尔基体扁平囊周围积累。在与Qa-SNARE界面的COG4一侧，保守残基D452和D453的丙氨酸替换降低了与STX5的共沉淀。将这些残基替换为丙氨酸或赖氨酸均保持了COG4定位及COG8向高尔基体的募集，但未能恢复COG4敲除细胞中的正常糖基化、GS15定位或改变的高尔基体形态。这些发现支持一个模型，即COG4-STX5界面将囊泡系连与有效的SNARE组装偶联，从而控制囊泡逆向运输和高尔基体组织。

papers.title: Physical constraints on the social-genetic dynamics of mtDNA inside plant mitochondria
papers.translated_title: 植物线粒体内mtDNA社会-遗传动力学的物理约束
papers.author: Chustecki, J. M.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encodes essential cellular machinery and is contained within mitochondria. This physical containment shapes the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations in the cell. In plants (and other non-bilaterians), mtDNA colocalisation is essential for recombination, while other cellular priorities may favour mtDNA spacing through the cell. Given possible physical interactions between mtDNA and the inner mitochondrial membrane and its cristae, it is not clear how readily or often this colocalisation may occur. Only limited, indirect evidence exists supporting the capacity for plant mtDNAs to physically colocalise. Here, we survey evidence from recent and new single-cell timelapse microscopy to quantitatively characterise the motion of mtDNA nucleoids inside vegetative plant cells. We combine biophysical arguments with new microscopy data and spatial statistics to demonstrate the subdiffusive but not internally static nature of nucleoids, demonstrating that they are enriched at the termini of elongated mitochondria and well-spaced through the cell but capable of colocalisation. We also describe other modes of physical motion that may impact the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations, and discuss the implication of this physical behaviour for cytoplasmic genetics.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）编码必需的细胞机器并存在于线粒体内部。这种物理上的封闭塑造了细胞中mtDNA群体的遗传动态。在植物（以及其他非两侧对称动物）中，mtDNA的共定位对于重组至关重要，而其他细胞优先事项可能有利于mtDNA在细胞中的间隔分布。鉴于mtDNA与线粒体内膜及其嵴之间可能存在物理相互作用，这种共定位可能发生的方式和频率尚不清楚。目前仅有有限的间接证据支持植物mtDNA能够发生物理共定位。在此，我们综述了来自近期和新的单细胞延时显微成像的证据，以定量表征营养期植物细胞中mtDNA拟核的运动。我们将生物物理学论证与新的显微数据和空间统计相结合，证明拟核具有亚扩散性但并非内部静止的特性，表明它们富集于 elongated mitochondria 的末端并在细胞中良好间隔分布，但能够发生共定位。我们还描述了其他可能影响mtDNA群体遗传动态的物理运动模式，并讨论了这种物理行为对细胞质遗传学的意义。

papers.title: Clinical translation of ultrasoft Fleuron probes for stable, high-density, and bidirectional brain interfaces
papers.translated_title: 超软Fleuron探针用于稳定、高密度和双向脑接口的临床转化
papers.author: Lee, J.
papers.summary: Building brain foundation models to capture the underpinning neural dynamics of human behavior requires large functional neural datasets for training, which current implantable Brain-Computer Interfaces (iBCIs) cannot achieve due to the instability of rigid materials in the brain. How can we realize high-density neural recordings with wide brain region access at single-neuron resolution, while maintaining the long-term stability required? In this study, we present a novel approach to overcome these trade-offs, by introducting Fleuron, a family of ultrasoft, ultra-low-k dielectric materials compatible with thin-film scalable microfabrication techniques. We successfully integrate up to 1,024 sites within a single minimally-invasive Fleuron depth electrode. The combination of the novel implant material and geometry enables single-unit level recordings for 18 months in rodent models, and achieves a large number of units detected per electrode across animals. 128-site Fleuron probes, that cover 8x larger tissue volume than state-of-the-art polyimide counterparts, can track over 100 single-units over months. Stability in neural recordings correlates with reduced glial encapsulation compared to polyimide controls up to 9-month post-implantation. Fleuron probes are integrated with a low-power, mixed-signal ASIC to achieve over 1,000 channels electronic interfaces and can be safely implanted in depth using minimally-invasive surgical techniques via a burr hole approach without requiring specialized robotics. Fleuron probes further create a unique contrast in clinical 3T MRI, allowing for post-operative position confirmation. Large-animal and ex vivo human tissue studies confirm safety and functionality in larger brains. Finally, Fleuron probes are used for the first time ever intraoperatively during planned resection surgeries, confirming in-human usability, and demonstrating the potential of the technology for clincical translation in iBCIs.
papers.translated_summary: 构建大脑基础模型以捕捉人类行为背后的神经动力学，需要大规模功能神经数据集进行训练，而当前的可植入脑机接口（iBCIs）由于刚性材料在大脑中的不稳定性而无法实现这一目标。我们如何在保持所需长期稳定性的同时，实现具有广泛脑区访问权限、单神经元分辨率的高密度神经记录？在本研究中，我们提出了一种克服这些权衡的新方法，引入了Fleuron，一类与薄膜可扩展微加工技术兼容的超柔软、超低介电常数材料系列。我们成功地在单个微创Fleuron深度电极内集成了多达1,024个位点。新型植入材料与几何形状的结合使得在啮齿动物模型中实现长达18个月的单单位水平记录，并在不同动物中实现每个电极检测到大量单位。128位点Fleuron探针覆盖的组织体积比最先进的聚酰亚胺对应物大8倍，可在数月内追踪超过100个单单位。与聚酰亚胺对照相比，植入后长达9个月内，神经记录的稳定性与减少的胶质封装相关。Fleuron探针集成了低功耗混合信号ASIC，以实现超过1,000通道的电子接口，并可通过钻孔方法的微创手术技术安全地深度植入，无需专用机器人。Fleuron探针进一步在临床3T MRI中产生独特对比，允许术后位置确认。大型动物和离体人类组织研究证实了在更大大脑中的安全性和功能性。最后，Fleuron探针首次在计划切除手术中术中应用，确认了人体可用性，并展示了该技术在iBCIs临床转化中的潜力。

papers.title: Plasma DNA fragmentomic analysis for evaluation of patients with pancreatic cystic neoplasms
papers.translated_title: 胰腺囊性肿瘤患者评估的血浆DNA片段组学分析
papers.author: Marcinak, C. T.
papers.summary: Background Incidental detection of pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) is common, but to identify patients with malignant PCNs (high-grade dysplasia or carcinoma) who need invasive testing such as endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) or surgery is challenging. Plasma DNA fragmentomic analysis has recently shown promise for early detection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). Objective To evaluate the ability of plasma DNA fragmentomic analysis to differentiate between patients with benign and malignant PCNs. Design We performed whole genome sequencing of pre-treatment plasma DNA from 121 patients with PDAC, 121 age and sex-matched healthy controls, and 99 patients with PCNs referred for EUS (total n=341). After training and validating a plasma DNA fragmentomics machine learning model for PDAC detection, we independently evaluated its performance for detection of malignant PCNs, and compared with circulating glycoproteins. Results Eleven of 99 patients (11%) were diagnosed with malignant PCNs during 24.6 months of clinical follow-up. For PDAC detection, plasma DNA analysis showed area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.97. For malignant PCN detection, plasma DNA analysis showed AUROC of 0.67, while CA19-9, CA125 and CEA showed AUROCs of 0.78, 0.54, and 0.63, respectively. Combined analysis of plasma DNA with glycoproteins showed AUROC of 0.92, demonstrating 91% sensitivity, 99% negative predictive value, 88% specificity and 48% positive predictive value for malignant PCN detection. Conclusion Plasma DNA fragmentomics and glycoprotein biomarkers showed complementary performance for detecting malignant PCNs in patients referred for EUS. This approach could improve patient selection for EUS, and warrants further evaluation.

papers.title: Systematic Review and External Validation of Clinical Prediction Models for Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes Using Routinely Collected Pre-Conception and Early Pregnancy Data
papers.translated_title: 系统综述与外部验证：利用常规收集的孕前和早孕期数据构建的不良妊娠结局临床预测模型
papers.author: Zhang, Y.
papers.summary: Background Although numerous clinical prediction models (CPMs) have been developed to identify pregnancies at risk of serious adverse outcomes, most lack robust external validation, which restricts their reliability in clinical practice. This study aims to systematically review and externally validate existing clinical prediction models for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), Pre-eclampsia (PE), Stillbirth, and Small-for-Gestational-Age (SGA), focusing on models for use in pre-conception or early pregnancy. The models were evaluated using a large, representative primary care cohort to assess their performance within a UK population. Methods Four two-stage systematic reviews identified CPMs for GDM, PE, Stillbirth, and SGA. Eligible models used routinely collected maternal characteristics available before conception or in early pregnancy and fully reported the model equation. Validation used the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Aurum, including over 1.58 million pregnancies among women aged 14-49 years between 2000 and 2019. Performance was assessed through discrimination (C-statistic), calibration-in-the-large (CITL), calibration slope and calibration plot, with pooled estimates across 20 imputations. Results Forty-eight models from 30 studies were included (47 binary and one continuous outcome), and 23 were developed in cohorts that included a UK population. Model development sample sizes ranged from 151 to 113,415 (median 5,013). Although 29 models had been externally validated, only one had been validated in a cohort including a UK population that met the required sample size and number of events. Across all outcomes, most models demonstrated limited generalisability in the UK population. C-statistics ranged from 0.57 to 0.77 for GDM, 0.50 to 0.72 for PE, 0.54 to 0.58 for stillbirth and 0.58 to 0.67 for SGA. Miscalibration was substantial across all outcomes, with CITL ranging from -6.14 to 9.64 (for binary-outcome models) and calibration slopes from 0.19 to 17.78. Conclusions Most existing CPMs that use pre-conception and early-pregnancy data to predict adverse pregnancy outcomes showed suboptimal discrimination and miscalibration in a large UK population, likely reflecting differences in population characteristics and outcome prevalence. Existing models are not suitable for direct implementation in UK practice and require further recalibration or updating using large, representative data before achieving clinical utility.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 尽管已开发出众多临床预测模型（CPMs）用于识别具有严重不良结局风险的妊娠，但大多数缺乏稳健的外部验证，这限制了其在临床实践中的可靠性。本研究旨在系统综述并外部验证现有的妊娠期糖尿病（GDM）、子痫前期（PE）、死产和小于胎龄儿（SGA）临床预测模型，重点关注用于孕前或早孕期的模型。这些模型在一个大型、具有代表性的初级保健队列中进行评估，以评价其在英国人群中的性能。方法 四项两阶段系统综述识别了GDM、PE、死产和SGA的CPMs。符合条件的模型使用孕前或早孕期可常规收集的母体特征，并完整报告了模型方程。验证使用临床实践研究数据链（CPRD）Aurum，涵盖2000年至2019年间14-49岁女性的超过158万次妊娠。通过区分度（C统计量）、大范围校准（CITL）、校准斜率和校准图评估性能，并对20次插补的估计值进行合并。结果 共纳入来自30项研究的48个模型（47个二分类结局和1个连续结局），其中23个模型在包含英国人群的队列中开发。模型开发样本量范围为151至113,415（中位数5,013）。尽管有29个模型经过外部验证，但仅有一个在包含英国人群且满足所需样本量和事件数的队列中经过验证。在所有结局中，大多数模型在英国人群中表现出有限的普遍性。C统计量范围为：GDM 0.57至0.77，PE 0.50至0.72，死产0.54至0.58，SGA 0.58至0.67。所有结局均存在显著校准不良，二分类结局模型的CITL范围为-6.14至9.64，校准斜率范围为0.19至17.78。结论 大多数使用孕前和早孕期数据预测不良妊娠结局的现有CPMs在大型英国人群中表现出次优的区分度和校准不良，可能反映了人群特征和结局患病率的差异。现有模型不适合直接在英国实践中实施，需要在实现临床效用之前使用大型、具有代表性的数据进一步重新校准或更新。

papers.title: Mechanistic Assessment of Norepinephrine Therapy versus Angiotensin-II on Organ Function in Septic Shock (MANTRA): Study Protocol for a multicenter open-label randomized trial
papers.translated_title: 去甲肾上腺素治疗与血管紧张素II对脓毒性休克器官功能的机制评估（MANTRA）：一项多中心开放标签随机试验的研究方案
papers.author: Filbin, M.
papers.summary: Introduction Norepinephrine remains first-line vasopressor therapy for septic shock despite its association at high doses with undesirable cardiovascular, kidney, and immune effects. Angiotensin-II (Ang-II) is a non-catecholamine vasopressor of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) now approved to increase blood pressure in vasodilatory shock. RAAS dysregulation is common in septic shock and may represent a treatable trait. However, few prospective investigations evaluate the effect of early Ang-II use in septic shock on dysfunctional RAAS biology, host-response, or clinical outcomes. Therefore, we designed a mechanistic clinical trial to test the hypothesis that early Ang-II therapy in septic shock normalizes systemic RAAS abnormalities and modulates innate immune responses. Methods and Analysis The Mechanistic Assessment of Norepinephrine TheRapy vs. Angiotensin-II in Septic Shock (MANTRA) trial is an investigator-initiated, prospective, multicenter, open-label, randomized mechanistic clinical trial. Adults with septic shock by Sepsis-3 criteria receiving a norepinephrine-equivalent dose (NED) of 0.10-0.50 mcg/kg/min will be randomized 1:1 to primary Ang-II (to a maximum 40 ng/kg/min) or norepinephrine (to a maximum 35 mcg/min) treatment strategies over a 48-hour period. The primary outcome is the between-group difference in plasma renin trajectory from baseline to 24 hours represented as a treatment-by-time interaction term in a linear mixed-effects model. With n=78, the trial has 90% power (at two-sided =0.05) to detect a 25% between-group difference in 24-hour renin. Secondary clinical outcomes include longitudinal NED, hours alive and vasopressor-free at 72 hours, a 28-day composite outcome (days alive and free of vasopressors, renal replacement therapy, and mechanical ventilation), treatment failure requiring crossover or protocol discontinuation, and thrombotic and arrhythmia events through 28 days. Secondary mechanistic outcomes include serial RAAS biomarkers (prorenin, soluble prorenin receptor, angiotensinogen, ACE, ACE2, Ang-II, angiotensin-(1-7), aldosterone, and DPP3), immune measures (ex vivo monocyte function, monocyte gene expression, plasma cytokines), and organ injury biomarkers. Enrollment is planned from 11/2026-7/2030. Ethics and Dissemination The study has been approved by the Advocate Health/Wake Forest University School of Medicine ethics commitee (IRB00115287). Informed consent is required. Results will be submitted for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presented at national and international scientific meetings, regardless of the direction of findings. Results will be posted to ClinicalTrials.gov. Trial Registration Clinicaltrials.gov - NCT06746753
papers.translated_summary: 引言 去甲肾上腺素仍然是脓毒性休克的一线血管升压药治疗，尽管高剂量使用与不良的心血管、肾脏和免疫效应相关。血管紧张素-II（Ang-II）是肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统（RAAS）的一种非儿茶酚胺类血管升压药，现已被批准用于升高血管舒张性休克患者的血压。RAAS失调在脓毒性休克中常见，可能代表一种可治疗的特征。然而，很少有前瞻性研究评估脓毒性休克早期使用Ang-II对功能失调的RAAS生物学、宿主反应或临床结局的影响。因此，我们设计了一项机制性临床试验，以检验以下假设：脓毒性休克早期Ang-II治疗可使全身RAAS异常正常化并调节先天免疫反应。 方法与分析 去甲肾上腺素治疗与血管紧张素-II在脓毒性休克中的机制性评估（MANTRA）试验是一项由研究者发起的、前瞻性、多中心、开放标签、随机机制性临床试验。符合Sepsis-3标准、接受去甲肾上腺素等效剂量（NED）0.10-0.50 mcg/kg/min的脓毒性休克成人患者将按1:1随机分配至以Ang-II为主（最大40 ng/kg/min）或去甲肾上腺素（最大35 mcg/min）的治疗策略，持续48小时。主要结局是基线至24小时血浆肾素轨迹的组间差异，以线性混合效应模型中的治疗-时间交互项表示。在n=78的情况下，该试验具有90%的把握度（双侧=0.05）检测24小时肾素的25%组间差异。次要临床结局包括纵向NED、72小时内存活且无血管升压药的小时数、28天复合结局（存活且无血管升压药、肾脏替代治疗和机械通气天数）、需要交叉或终止方案的治療失败，以及至28天的血栓和心律失常事件。次要机制性结局包括系列RAAS生物标志物（肾素原、可溶性肾素原受体、血管紧张素原、ACE、ACE2、Ang-II、血管紧张素-(1-7)、醛固酮和DPP3）、免疫指标（离体单核细胞功能、单核细胞基因表达、血浆细胞因子）和器官损伤生物标志物。计划入组时间为2026年11月至2030年7月。 伦理与传播 该研究已获Advocate Health/Wake Forest大学医学院伦理委员会批准（IRB00115287）。需要知情同意。结果将提交在同行评审期刊上发表，并在国家和国际科学会议上展示，无论结果方向如何。结果将发布在ClinicalTrials.gov上。 试验注册 Clinicaltrials.gov - NCT06746753

papers.title: Genome-wide analyses identify 147 loci associated with obstructive sleep apnea
papers.translated_title: 全基因组分析识别出147个与阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停相关的基因座
papers.author: Garcia-Marin, L. M.
papers.summary: The genetic components underlying obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) remain poorly understood. Here, we conducted the largest GWAS meta-analysis (OSA; Ncases= 232,292; Ncontrols= 1,259,390) using European ancestry genetic data from five countries. We identified 147 independent loci and estimated SNP-based heritability at 16%. We report six independent loci in a separate African population meta-analysis (Ncases= 46,834; Ncontrols= 149,192). Spatially resolved gene enrichment in neural circuits involved synaptic transmission, including GABAergic and glutamatergic signalling, and cytoskeletal remodelling. OSA-derived polygenic risk scores predicted clinician-ascertained OSA status, Fitbit-derived sleep features, and symptom-based OSA risk and snoring in participants of diverse ancestral backgrounds. We identified putative causal relationships with ADHD, depression, multisite chronic pain, body mass index, and schizophrenia, among others. Our findings demonstrate a substantial genetic component underlying OSA risk beyond shared genetic effects with body mass index, implicating neurobiological pathways related to synaptic function and corticothalamic feedback loops.
papers.translated_summary: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）的遗传基础仍知之甚少。在此，我们利用来自五个国家的欧洲血统遗传数据，开展了规模最大的GWAS荟萃分析（OSA：病例数=232,292；对照数=1,259,390）。我们识别出147个独立位点，并估计基于SNP的遗传率为16%。我们在另一项非洲人群荟萃分析中报告了6个独立位点（病例数=46,834；对照数=149,192）。空间分辨的基因富集分析显示，涉及突触传递的神经回路（包括GABA能和谷氨酸能信号传导）以及细胞骨架重塑。源自OSA的多基因风险评分能够预测临床医生确诊的OSA状态、Fitbit衍生的睡眠特征，以及不同祖先背景参与者的基于症状的OSA风险和打鼾。我们识别出与ADHD、抑郁症、多部位慢性疼痛、体重指数和精神分裂症等之间的推定因果关系。我们的研究结果表明，除与体重指数的共享遗传效应之外，OSA风险存在显著的遗传成分，涉及与突触功能和皮质丘脑反馈环路相关的神经生物学通路。

papers.title: Hitchhiker bias can distort inference of pathogen severity and pathogen-pathogen interactions from symptom-based surveillance: A modeling study
papers.translated_title: 搭便车偏倚可能扭曲基于症状监测对病原体严重性和病原体-病原体相互作用的推断：一项建模研究
papers.author: Kumari, K.
papers.summary: Symptom-based infectious disease surveillance, which infers pathogen circulation by testing individuals who seek care for clinical symptoms, is widely used in public health but can distort our understanding of pathogen dynamics. Detecting a pathogen in a hospitalized patient does not establish that it caused the hospitalization. When a mildly pathogenic virus is detected in patients hospitalized because of a co-infecting, more pathogenic virus, the hospitalization can be wrongly attributed to the mild virus, a mechanism we term hitchhiker bias. Building on the aetiology-attribution literature, we couple this misattribution to a two-pathogen SEIR model with explicit co-infection and multiplex observation, and ask how an unmodeled incidental-detection pathway is absorbed into the parameters estimated by transmission models. We show that the relative inflation of observed hospitalizations is governed by the ratio of the two viruses' hospitalization probabilities and by the fraction of mild-virus infections that are co-infections. In simulation-estimation experiments, ignoring the hitchhiker pathway overestimated the hospitalization probability of the mild virus about 3-fold under partial and 7-fold under complete epidemic overlap, with credible intervals that excluded the true value. In the absence of biological interaction, it also overestimated the mild virus's reproduction number and generated spurious inhibition under partial overlap, and generated spurious facilitation under complete overlap. When the viruses truly interacted, the bias in the estimated interaction depended on epidemic overlap: a true inhibition appeared stronger under partial overlap but was reversed into weak facilitation under complete overlap, and a true facilitation appeared stronger. Explicitly modeling the hitchhiker pathway recovered hospitalization probabilities and interaction strengths when the observation model was correctly specified. These results highlight the importance of separating pathogen-attributable hospitalization from incidental detection when drawing epidemiological inferences from symptom-based surveillance.
papers.translated_summary: 基于症状的传染病监测通过检测因临床症状就诊的个体来推断病原体传播情况，在公共卫生领域被广泛使用，但可能扭曲我们对病原体动力学的理解。在住院患者中检测到某种病原体，并不能确定该病原体导致了住院。当一种致病性较弱的病毒在因合并感染致病性更强的病毒而住院的患者中被检测到时，住院可能被错误地归因于这种弱病毒，我们将这一机制称为搭便车偏倚。基于病因归因文献，我们将这种错误归因与一个双病原体SEIR模型相结合，该模型包含明确的合并感染和多路观测，并探讨未被建模的偶然检测路径如何被吸收到传播模型所估计的参数中。我们表明，观测到的住院相对膨胀由两种病毒的住院概率之比以及弱病毒感染中属于合并感染的比例所决定。在模拟-估计实验中，忽略搭便车路径会使弱病毒的住院概率在部分疫情重叠下被高估约3倍、在完全疫情重叠下被高估约7倍，且可信区间排除了真实值。在不存在生物学交互作用的情况下，它还会高估弱病毒的再生数，并在部分重叠下产生虚假抑制，在完全重叠下产生虚假促进。当病毒确实存在交互作用时，估计交互作用的偏倚取决于疫情重叠程度：真实抑制在部分重叠下显得更强，但在完全重叠下逆转为弱促进；真实促进则显得更强。当观测模型被正确设定时，显式建模搭便车路径能够恢复住院概率和交互强度。这些结果凸显了在从基于症状的监测中得出流行病学推断时，将病原体可归因住院与偶然检测区分开来的重要性。

papers.title: Evaluation of a Brief Educational Intervention to Improve Healthcare Provider Communication About Autism Genetic Testing
papers.translated_title: 评估一项简短教育干预对改善医疗服务提供者关于自闭症基因检测沟通的效果
papers.author: Pilson, O. G.
papers.summary: Although professional guidelines recommend offering genetic testing following an autism diagnosis, uptake remains low in the United States. Healthcare providers frequently report limited education and uncertainty discussing autism genetics with patients and families. We developed and evaluated a brief educational intervention to improve provider communication about autism genetic testing, consisting of animated videos addressing autism genetics, available testing options, and strategies for discussing testing with autistic individuals and families. We evaluated the intervention among 100 U.S.-based healthcare providers and a community panel of 99 autistic adults. Participants completed a validated measure of genetic literacy before viewing the videos, then evaluated the intervention and its perceived impact on genetic testing. Providers showed higher genetic literacy than the general U.S. population, yet only 23% reported frequently discussing genetic testing before the intervention. Afterward, 86% reported greater likelihood of recommending genetic testing following diagnosis, and 88% reported the videos changed how they would discuss genetics with patients and families. Both cohorts rated the resources favorably, and 71% of autistic adults reported greater likelihood of pursuing genetic testing after viewing the videos. Brief, communication-focused educational resources may improve workflows for autism genetic testing and support informed decision-making for providers, autistic individuals, and their families.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管专业指南建议在自闭症诊断后提供基因检测，但在美国其接受率仍然很低。医疗保健提供者经常报告称，在与患者和家庭讨论自闭症遗传学方面受教育有限且缺乏把握。我们开发并评估了一项简短的教育干预措施，旨在改善提供者关于自闭症基因检测的沟通，该干预由动画视频组成，内容涉及自闭症遗传学、可用的检测选项以及与自闭症个体和家庭讨论检测的策略。我们在100名美国医疗保健提供者和一个由99名自闭症成人组成的社区小组中评估了该干预措施。参与者在观看视频前完成了一项经过验证的遗传知识测量，然后评估了该干预措施及其对基因检测的感知影响。提供者表现出高于美国普通人群的遗传知识水平，然而在干预前仅有23%报告经常讨论基因检测。之后，86%报告在诊断后推荐基因检测的可能性增加，88%报告视频改变了他们与患者和家庭讨论遗传学的方式。两个群体对这些资源评价良好，71%的自闭症成人在观看视频后报告追求基因检测的可能性增加。简短的、以沟通为重点的教育资源可能改善自闭症基因检测的工作流程，并支持提供者、自闭症个体及其家庭做出知情决策。

papers.title: Quantification of Bias-Variance Tradeoffs in Genome-Wide Polygenic Indices: When 'Good' PGIs are Bad and 'Bad' PGIs are Good
papers.translated_title: 全基因组多基因指数的偏差-方差权衡量化：当“好”的多基因指数是坏的，“坏”的多基因指数是好的
papers.author: Dragostinov, Y.
papers.summary: Polygenic indices (PGIs) are downwardly biased in their predictive accuracies in independent samples due to the presence of estimation error in Genome-Wide Association Studies (GWAS) from which they are constructed. By performing GWAS of the same phenotype in independent samples, we obtain to error-corrected estimates of PGI prediction accuracy, which we use to estimate the extent to which different PGI construction methods (unadjusted, Clumping, LDpred2-inf, LDpred2-auto, SBayesR, PRS-CS-auto) index total single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) heritability. To ensure practicality of this approach when individual-level data from the original GWAS are not available, we provide a means of synthetically splitting existing GWAS summary statistics into independent halves. In both simulated and empirical data, we find that advanced PGI construction methods that produce enhanced uncorrected prediction accuracies (often by shrinking individual SNP effects towards zero or exactly to zero) also produce deflated error-corrected prediction accuracies. LDpred2-inf, which most closely resembles a multiple regression estimator to account for linkage disequilibrium without further aggressive shrinkage, consistently produces PGIs with relatively lower uncorrected prediction accuracies but higher error-corrected prediction accuracies that nearly fully recover SNP heritability. We show that PGI construction methods that implement aggressive shrinkage may also provide biased patterns of associations with collateral phenotypes, irrespective of error correction. By providing a means of straightforwardly obtaining error-corrected estimates of prediction accuracy using PGIs derived from standard GWAS summary statistics, we have highlighted an uncommonly recognized bias-variance tradeoff associated with the choice of PGI construction methods.
papers.translated_summary: 多基因指数（PGIs）在独立样本中的预测准确性存在向下偏倚，这是因为构建这些指数所依据的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中存在估计误差。通过在独立样本中对同一表型进行GWAS，我们获得了经过误差校正的PGI预测准确性估计值，并用其评估不同PGI构建方法（未调整、Clumping、LDpred2-inf、LDpred2-auto、SBayesR、PRS-CS-auto）对总单核苷酸多态性（SNP）遗传力的索引程度。为确保在原始GWAS的个体水平数据不可用时该方法的实用性，我们提供了一种将现有GWAS汇总统计量合成拆分为独立两半的方法。在模拟数据和实证数据中，我们发现，能够产生更高未校正预测准确性（通常通过将单个SNP效应向零收缩或精确收缩至零）的先进PGI构建方法，也会产生被压低的误差校正预测准确性。LDpred2-inf最接近于多元回归估计器，能够在考虑连锁不平衡的同时不进行进一步的激进收缩，其一致地产生未校正预测准确性相对较低但误差校正预测准确性较高的PGI，后者几乎完全恢复了SNP遗传力。我们表明，实施激进收缩的PGI构建方法还可能产生与附属表型之间带有偏倚的关联模式，无论是否进行误差校正。通过提供一种使用源自标准GWAS汇总统计量的PGI直接获得误差校正预测准确性估计值的方法，我们揭示了与PGI构建方法选择相关的一种未被普遍认识到的偏差-方差权衡。

papers.title: Escape from X-chromosome inactivation increases disease risk and drives sex-differential genetic effects: a population-scale PheXWAS
papers.translated_title: 逃离X染色体失活增加疾病风险并驱动性别差异遗传效应：一项人群规模的PheXWAS研究
papers.author: Perez-Elena, M. A.
papers.summary: X chromosome (Xchr) contribution to complex traits remains incomplete, due to its unique inheritance pattern and its inactivation mechanism. Therefore, we gathered data from 800,000 individuals from the UK Biobank and dbGaP, and performed a sex-stratified phenome-wide association study of Xchr variation across 3,741 complex traits. Heritability analyses revealed sex-specific patterns and an overall involvement of Xchr in complex phenotypes. We identified 6,531 loci significantly associated with 402 complex traits, with a higher proportion of associations consistent with dominant inheritance than observed for autosomes. Although effect directions were largely concordant between sexes, loci with significant effect-size differences were enriched for escape-gene associations. Escape genes were depleted among trait-associated loci and strongly enriched for risky disease effects. These association patterns enabled prediction of escape status for unannotated genes. This overview of Xchr contribution to complex traits suggests inactivation escape as a clear risky feature for females.
papers.translated_summary: X染色体（Xchr）对复杂性状的贡献仍不完整，这是由于其独特的遗传模式及其失活机制。因此，我们汇集了来自英国生物银行和dbGaP的80万人的数据，并对3,741个复杂性状的Xchr变异进行了性别分层全表型关联研究。遗传力分析揭示了性别特异性模式以及Xchr在复杂表型中的整体参与。我们识别出6,531个与402个复杂性状显著相关的位点，其中与显性遗传一致的关联比例高于常染色体中所观察到的比例。尽管效应方向在性别之间基本一致，但具有显著效应大小差异的位点在逃逸基因关联中富集。逃逸基因在性状相关位点中 depleted，并在风险性疾病效应中强烈富集。这些关联模式使得能够预测未注释基因的逃逸状态。这一关于Xchr对复杂性状贡献的概述表明，失活逃逸是女性中的一个明显风险特征。

papers.title: Transcriptional aging across CNS tissues in the ALS-FTD spectrum reflects clock architecture and disease-associated cellular signatures
papers.translated_title: ALS-FTD谱系中CNS各组织的转录衰老反映时钟架构和疾病相关细胞特征
papers.author: Zhao, T.
papers.summary: Background. We examined transcriptomic (gene expression-based) aging in postmortem central nervous system (CNS) tissues from donors across the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-frontotemporal dementia (FTD) spectrum and investigated the molecular and cellular features underlying disease-associated differences in transcriptional aging clocks. Methods. Six transcriptomic clocks (RNAAgeCalc DESeq2, GTExAge, Pearson and GenAge; Pasta REG and age-shift) were applied to 2,235 RNA-sequencing samples from 609 donors across 11 CNS regions, with adjustment for age and tissue-specific technical variables. We compared transcriptional age across ALS, ALS-FTD, FTD, and controls, examining regional variation, gene-level contributions, cell composition, disease duration, and C9orf72 status, with independent validation of gene contributions in a cervical spinal cord cohort. Results. Disease-associated differences in transcriptional age varied by diagnosis, tissue, and clock. ALS and ALS-FTD showed the strongest differences in spinal cord, while FTD differences localized primarily to the frontal and temporal cortex. In ALS spinal cord, RNAAgeCalc DESeq2 estimates were lower than controls, whereas other clocks estimated higher transcriptional age when significant. CHIT1 was identified as the primary contributor to the DESeq2 transcriptional age decrease in ALS. Cell composition adjustment attenuated ALS spinal cord differences, reflecting microglial, lymphocyte, oligodendrocyte, and astrocyte signatures, though the lumbar GenAge increase in transcriptional age and DESeq2 decrease remained significant. The higher transcriptional age in ALS motor cortex also remained significantafter adjustment. Clinical associations were likewise clock dependent. Higher spinal DESeq2 age acceleration (AA) was associated with longer ALS duration, though this association was strongly influenced by the CHIT1 term. Higher GTExAge AA in cervical spinal cord, thoracic spinal cord, and occipital cortex was associated with shorter disease duration; no significant associations were observed for the other clock-tissue combinations or for ALS-FTD. No clock differed by C9orf72 repeat expansion status. Conclusions. In this study we found disease-associated differences in transcriptional age that localize to clinically relevant tissues. Differences in transcriptional aging across the ALS-FTD spectrum reflect interactions among clock architecture, disease-associated gene expression, tissue region, and cellular composition. Resolving these components reveals the biological context underlying divergent clock estimates and provides a framework for interpreting changes in transcriptional aging.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。我们研究了来自肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）-额颞叶痴呆（FTD）谱系供者的死后中枢神经系统（CNS）组织中的转录组（基于基因表达）衰老，并探讨了疾病相关转录衰老时钟差异背后的分子和细胞特征。方法。我们将六种转录组时钟（RNAAgeCalc DESeq2、GTExAge、Pearson和GenAge；Pasta REG和age-shift）应用于来自609名供者、涵盖11个CNS区域的2,235份RNA测序样本，并对年龄和组织特异性技术变量进行了校正。我们比较了ALS、ALS-FTD、FTD和对照组的转录年龄，考察了区域变异、基因水平贡献、细胞组成、疾病病程和C9orf72状态，并在一个颈髓队列中对基因贡献进行了独立验证。结果。疾病相关转录年龄差异因诊断、组织和时钟而异。ALS和ALS-FTD在脊髓中显示出最强的差异，而FTD的差异主要局限于额叶和颞叶皮层。在ALS脊髓中，RNAAgeCalc DESeq2估计值低于对照组，而其他时钟在显著时估计出更高的转录年龄。CHIT1被确定为ALS中DESeq2转录年龄降低的主要贡献者。细胞组成校正减弱了ALS脊髓差异，反映了小胶质细胞、淋巴细胞、少突胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞特征，尽管腰段GenAge转录年龄升高和DESeq2降低仍然显著。ALS运动皮层中较高的转录年龄在校正后也仍然显著。临床关联同样依赖于时钟。较高的脊髓DESeq2年龄加速（AA）与较长的ALS病程相关，尽管这一关联受到CHIT1项的强烈影响。颈髓、胸髓和枕叶皮层中较高的GTExAge AA与较短的疾病病程相关；其他时钟-组织组合或ALS-FTD未观察到显著关联。没有时钟因C9orf72重复扩增状态而存在差异。结论。在本研究中，我们发现了定位于临床相关组织的疾病相关转录年龄差异。ALS-FTD谱系中转录衰老的差异反映了时钟架构、疾病相关基因表达、组织区域和细胞组成之间的相互作用。解析这些组成部分揭示了导致不同时钟估计的生物学背景，并为解释转录衰老变化提供了框架。
